## NeoPilotRemoteEndpoint

NeoPilotRemoteEndpoint lets you connect actions and agents written in Python to your 
    NeoPilot application.

    To install NeoPilot for Python, run:

    ```bash
    pip install neopilot
    # or to include crewai
    pip install neopilot[crewai]
    ```

    ## Adding actions

    In this example, we provide a simple action to the Copilot:

    ```python
    from neopilot import NeoPilotRemoteEndpoint, Action

    sdk = NeoPilotRemoteEndpoint(
        actions=[
            Action(
                name="greet_user",
                handler=greet_user_handler,
                description="Greet the user",
                parameters=[
                    {
                        "name": "name",
                        "type": "string",
                        "description": "The name of the user"
                    }
                ]
            )
        ]
    )
    ```

    You can also dynamically build actions by providing a callable that returns a list of actions.
    In this example, we use "name" from the `properties` object to parameterize the action handler.

    ```python
    from neopilot import NeoPilotRemoteEndpoint, Action

    sdk = NeoPilotRemoteEndpoint(
        actions=lambda context: [
            Action(
                name="greet_user",
                handler=make_greet_user_handler(context["properties"]["name"]), 
                description="Greet the user"
            )
        ]
    )
    ```

    Using the same approach, you can restrict the actions available to the Copilot:

    ```python
    from neopilot import NeoPilotRemoteEndpoint, Action

    sdk = NeoPilotRemoteEndpoint(
        actions=lambda context: (
            [action_a, action_b] if is_admin(context["properties"]["token"]) else [action_a]
        )
    )
    ```

    ## Adding agents

    Serving agents works in a similar way to serving actions:

    ```python
    from neopilot import NeoPilotRemoteEndpoint, LangGraphAgent
    from my_agent.agent import graph

    sdk = NeoPilotRemoteEndpoint(
        agents=[
            LangGraphAgent(
                name="email_agent",
                description="This agent sends emails",
                graph=graph,
            )
        ]
    )
    ```

    To dynamically build agents, provide a callable that returns a list of agents:

    ```python
    from neopilot import NeoPilotRemoteEndpoint, LangGraphAgent
    from my_agent.agent import graph

    sdk = NeoPilotRemoteEndpoint(
        agents=lambda context: [
            LangGraphAgent(
                name="email_agent",
                description="This agent sends emails",
                graph=graph,
                langgraph_config={
                    "token": context["properties"]["token"]
                }
            )
        ]
    )
    ```

    To restrict the agents available to the Copilot, simply return a different list of agents based on the `context`:

    ```python
    from neopilot import NeoPilotRemoteEndpoint
    from my_agents import agent_a, agent_b, is_admin

    sdk = NeoPilotRemoteEndpoint(
        agents=lambda context: (
            [agent_a, agent_b] if is_admin(context["properties"]["token"]) else [agent_a]
        )
    )
    ```

    ## Serving the NeoPilot SDK

    To serve the NeoPilot SDK, you can use the `add_readyapi_endpoint` function from the `neopilot.integrations.readyapi` module:

    ```python
    from neopilot.integrations.readyapi import add_readyapi_endpoint
    from readyapi import ReadyAPI

    app = ReadyAPI()
    sdk = NeoPilotRemoteEndpoint(...)
    add_readyapi_endpoint(app, sdk, "/neopilot")

    def main():
        uvicorn.run(
            "your_package:app",
            host="0.0.0.0",
            port=8000,
            reload=True,
        )

    ```

### Parameters

<PropertyReference name="actions" type="Optional[Union[List[Action], Callable[[NeoPilotContext], List[Action]]]]" > 
The actions to make available to the Copilot.
</PropertyReference>

<PropertyReference name="agents" type="Optional[Union[List[Agent], Callable[[NeoPilotContext], List[Agent]]]]" > 
The agents to make available to the Copilot.
</PropertyReference>

## NeoPilotContext

NeoPilot Context

### Parameters

<PropertyReference name="properties" type="Any" required> 
The properties provided to the frontend via `<NeoPilot properties={...} />`
</PropertyReference>

<PropertyReference name="frontend_url" type="Optional[str]" > 
The current URL of the frontend
</PropertyReference>

<PropertyReference name="headers" type="Mapping[str, str]" required> 
The headers of the request
</PropertyReference>
